column1: # DripDrop custom partition table (4 MB flash).
# Reclaims ~512 KB from the oversized filesystem into the two OTA app slots.
# App slots: 1.5 MB each (was 1.25 MB). Filesystem: 896 KB (was 1.44 MB);
# the React webapp build is ~590 KB
# NOTE: changing the partition table cannot be done over HTTP OTA (that only
# rewrites an app slot). Devices already in the field need a one-time serial
